memory_update.text: Direct high-purity quartz and semiconductor quartz-crucible public-market exposure is scarce in US listings; Spruce Pine-linked HPQ assets appear mainly tied to private or non-US-listed entities such as Sibelco and The Quartz Corp.

For US-listed equities, the more investable map of this node likely sits in second-order ultra-clean materials, filtration, gas/chemical delivery, process-control, and wafer-cleaning suppliers rather than direct HPQ mining or crucible production.

UCTT is a higher-priority underfollowed candidate for further Layer 2 work because it combines semiconductor subsystem exposure with ultra-high-purity cleaning, analytical services, gas delivery, and chemical delivery modules.

ACMR should remain in the speculative-shadow lane until evidence confirms that cleaning step intensity, customer qualifications, and non-China adoption link its growth to the broader ultra-clean wafer-processing chokepoint.

node: High-purity quartz, crucibles, wafers, and ultra-clean semiconductor materials
summary: Expanded the public-market map around the upstream semiconductor materials chokepoint. Direct high-purity quartz assets such as Spruce Pine appear largely private or embedded in non-US-listed owners, so the US-listed discovery lane shifts to adjacent ultra-clean materials, filtration, specialty gas/chemical delivery, wafer cleaning, contamination control, and process-control suppliers. The strongest US-listed candidates are not direct HPQ miners or crucible makers; they are second-order beneficiaries whose products become more critical as fabs move to tighter contamination tolerances, more complex process steps, and higher wafer/packaging volumes.
